items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I think his name was Rosenthal, Lenny Rosenthal... But he was so marvelous with my son... And then he used to call and tell me, you know, when I'd come to town.

ctx.x: He did very, very, very well. And as a matter of fact he studied for about four years at Fine Arts Conservatory.

The young fellow that was teaching him had never travelled, you know, with a big band, and he wanted to travel. I think his name was Rosenthal, Lenny Rosenthal. And he wanted to travel, you know. But he was so marvelous with my son, and my son just adored him and he adored my son, and he did just very, very, very, very well. And then he used to call and tell me, you know, when I'd come to town. I travelled quite a bit at that time, but I had a housekeeper that used to, you know, keep me informed, and I'd call…

But when Lenny decided that he no longer was going to teach, you know, he was going to give it up for awhile, and he had all of his students assigned to someone else. And my son said to me -- his first assignment with this teacher, he didn't like him. He'd made up his mind he wasn't going to like him.
